$comment: Capstone, gate-ON condition: the whole constitution mechanized. Every edit-time hook the series built is registered at once, including the capstone's widened sealing vocabulary, the raw-icon rule, the four MVVM rules and the capstone-residue rules, because those ride inside the existing seal and shape hooks which run the repo eslint config. The responsive gate stays soft, as Part 5 disclosed: it is an instruction in the stage prompts to run npm run check:responsive and fix until it passes, because Playwright needs a whole rendered app and a per-edit hook is physically impossible. strictTemplates is on in both conditions. protect-enforcement is present in BOTH conditions and is an experimental control, not a gate.
